Name: Animal Dialogue Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is a framework that lets modders use Content Patcher to give dialogue to the various types of silent NPCs in the game.

[b]It isn't meant to do anything on its own.[/b]

The content patcher paths to target are:

[b]Characters/Dialogue/<NameOrType>
[b]Portraits/<NameOrType>[/b]
[/b]
Replace [b]<NameOrType>[/b] with either the specific name of the NPC or the type. Types for pets and monsters must be the actual type ([b]Cat[/b], [b]Dog[/b], [b]Bat[/b], etc.). Junimo types are either [b]Junimo[/b] or [b]JunimoHarvester[/b].

I have only tested this with horses, cats, and mummies; it's still experimental, let me know whether it works with the other NPC types.

If it causes problems with any NPC type you can disable that type in the config.



[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
